title: Regulators in Europe were largely left out of the loop as Anthropic limited the release of its latest model Mythos to select companies and organizations (Politico)
summary: Politico: Regulators in Europe were largely left out of the loop as Anthropic limited the release of its latest model Mythos to select companies and organizations — BRUSSELS — Regulators in Europe have been left out of the loop as U.S. firm Anthropic restricts the release of a new, powerful artificial intelligence model.
